title: Bronze Torch Holder
content: I just had a weird intuition that one of you out there in Blogland needs some reference for a dragon torch holder.Maybe you’re a concept artist or a fantasy illustrator or a set designer. Maybe you’re working on a design for a castle of vampires or a lair of dragon tamers. Anyway, here it is for the taking. The piece is from Siena, Italy, and I found it in on page 395 of an 1887 edition of the Magazine of Art.----Download the 1887 Magazine of Artfrom Google Books
